drafted_from: tool:github:breakthrough-pyscenedetect's row in tools/tools-from-github/tool-rows.json (job, run, get_it, needs) and its sources row in sources.json; the command is the row's own run line with synthetic names filled in. What it prints or writes is read from the tool's documented behavior; the folder test test/index-github-tools.test.mjs only checks the row, never runs PySceneDetect.
start_here: Say to your AI: "Use PySceneDetect on my computer to find the cuts and scenes in a video and split it into clips: the file is tour.mp4." It reads the row, installs PySceneDetect if it is missing, runs it on that one file and shows you what it made.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: PySceneDetect is a program that runs on the person's own computer and works on the one file or address it is handed.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Use PySceneDetect on tour.mp4". It reads the row with run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools, method tools:list, input {tool: "tool:github:breakthrough-pyscenedetect"}.

2. It checks that python, ffmpeg are on your computer, and if PySceneDetect is missing it runs the get_it steps: git clone https://github.com/Breakthrough/PySceneDetect.git ; pip install scenedetect --upgrade.
3. It runs the row's command with your file in place of {input}: scenedetect -i tour.mp4 split-video
4. Read what it shows you and open the result. Trillion runs none of this; it all happens on your own computer.

worked_examples.title: PySceneDetect on a 90 second shop tour video with several cuts
worked_examples.given: Read from tools/tools-from-github/tool-rows.json: tool:github:breakthrough-pyscenedetect runs on your computer, so after tools:list the AI runs, in the folder it got PySceneDetect in, the command line: scenedetect -i tour.mp4 split-video  (synthetic input: a 90 second shop tour video with several cuts).
worked_examples.hands_back: scenedetect prints how many scenes it found (a line such as "Detected 6 scenes, average shot length 15.0 seconds.") and splits tour.mp4 into one clip per scene named tour-Scene-001.mp4, tour-Scene-002.mp4 and so on.
